## How to choose the right one

When you call, ask these four questions\:

- **Who will handle my case?** Will I speak directly with the attorney or mainly with a case manager?
- **Have you handled cases like mine?** Ask for relevant verdicts or settlements and whether those cases went to trial.
- **What is your fee?** Confirm the contingency percentage, case expenses, and what happens if you don't recover money.
- **What is my claim potentially worth?** Ask how medical costs, lost wages, future treatment, and insurance limits affect the estimate.

You can also verify an attorney's license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of Georgia](https://www.gabar.org/)\.
